originStory.title: Why I Made This Bundle
originStory.subtitle: For those who want to own, not rent
originStory.story: When I launched the [Knowii Community](/product/knowii-community) subscription, I heard from a different kind of customer. They'd say: *'I love your products, but I don't want live events. I don't need community access. I just want to buy everything and learn at my own pace.'* Independent learners. Introverts. Busy people who preferred private study over public engagement. Professionals who hated watching subscriptions drain their accounts month after month. They wanted **ownership**, not rental. **One decision**, not ongoing commitments. So I made the Everything Knowledge Bundle. Every course, every kit, every workshop, every tool. **One purchase, yours forever**. You learn when you want, how you want, with no community pressure and no recurring fees. This isn't a downgrade from the subscription. It's a different philosophy: **complete ownership** for independent learners who know exactly what they want.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Customers kept asking: *'Can I just buy everything and skip the community?'* This is that answer.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years Distilled Into One Bundle
creatorJourney.subtitle: Every system I use, now yours
creatorJourney.story: I've spent over **two decades** building knowledge systems. I've tried every tool, every methodology, every approach. I failed hard. A startup that cost me **200k€** and two years of my life. I burned out trying to succeed through sheer willpower. Eventually, I built systems that actually work. Today, I manage nearly **10,000 notes** in my personal vault. I run a half-time business alongside a corporate IT role. I've written **hundres of articles**, published **3 books**, and created courses used by thousands. I raise 3 kids and stay calm through it all. These aren't theoretical frameworks; they're systems I use daily. The Everything Knowledge Bundle contains everything I've learned. The [Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit) covers **13 topics**. The courses teach `Obsidian` and PKM from foundations to mastery. The AI tools help you scale content creation without losing your voice. The [PKM Library](/product/pkm-library) gives you **2,000+ resources** I curated during 12 months of startup research, and continuing to grow.
